note: Book 3: does training on more wordings carry the facts to a wording never trained on? Full layer-23 FFN, Adam lr 3e-6, the 39 prefectures outside the held-out 8. Wordings a-d (examples/prefecture-capitals-train-39{,-b,-c,-d}.jsonl) are trained in sets of 1, 2 or 4; wording e (examples/prefecture-capitals-probe-e.jsonl) is never trained and is scored by free answers (lens-batch --generate 16). Forced-position counts for e are not comparable: e has no forced prefix, so its first reply token is the capital only for runs trained on the bare-answer wording c. Findings: one wording already carries the 8 trained facts to wording e (7/8 at 100 steps, 8/8 at 400, KL 0.014/0.029); four wordings also reach 8/8 but change the model more (KL 0.069) while keeping the same-name prefectures right in e (27/28 vs 22/28 with one wording). No run learns a held-out prefecture (0-1/8). Consistent with the probe (cpu-prefecture-capitals-probe.json): the layer-23 input encodes the prefecture the same way in every wording.
